prs.body:
Teachers can move from the Teaching Desk to an exact saved response and prepare an intervention while retaining the assignment, investigation and selected evidence. This is the first Workbench v2.2 vertical slice against the existing authenticated loaders and intervention services.

## Scope

- Shared teacher shell and validated URL context retain existing routes, Materials/Objectives access and the student shell.
- Teaching priorities use recorded metrics. Evidence preserves original text, accepted evaluation identity, uncertainty, displayed assistance, source versions and separate response/distinct-student counts.
- Single-response and selected-response handoffs use the existing evidence builder, including related and contrary answers. Preview remains a GET; generation, saving, recipient choice, approval and delivery remain explicit existing actions.

No authentication, API handler, database schema, evaluation/tutor state, content resolver or intervention lifecycle implementation changes.

## Second independent review corrections

Corrective commit: `94e4e534ea4d68d86ea0810067497bf07258e6d2`, based on reviewed head `76b11ddfa0ce784f70290c0746efd94c7042f6fc`.

1. **Saved-draft scope:** shared navigation uses the authorized persisted snapshot, ignoring conflicting raw URL fields. Newly acknowledged generation/recovery results validate the returned draft and assignment before updating state, then replace the complete investigation URL. Course and assignment destinations retain only their appropriate scope.
2. **Evaluation wording:** pending, failed and rejected evaluations no longer imply an accepted result exists. Historical accepted results and later unsuccessful retries are distinguished using the actual accepted pointer. A later failed retry does not remove the response's existing preparation eligibility.
3. **List position and focus:** response selection keeps the results component mounted. Stable response anchors and history-entry scroll/focus memory preserve the originating row across detail inspection, return, Back/Forward and reload. Filter scope isolates restoration; checkbox changes preserve focus.
4. **Blocked mobile navigation:** the containing drawer closes before the page-owned explanation is focused. The explanation preserves unsaved text and offers a route to save/discard controls or the pending action. Guard handling does not repeat a mutation. The shared workspace component was not changed.

The previous five corrections remain in place: isolated preparation recovery, visible/focused evidence anchors, constrained explicit evidence identities, saved-snapshot inspection links, and separate recorded-help/concept-independence labels.

## Verification on the corrective commit

- **547 unit tests passed**, zero failures/skips; **34 additional cases** cover the four correction groups and acknowledgement recovery. Previous five regression groups pass.
- Lint, typecheck, formatting, production build, content validation (**293 checks**) and diff check passed.
- Baseline browser reproductions confirmed stale navigation, list scroll/focus loss and hidden mobile feedback. The evaluation wording baseline was reproduced by executing the original source condition with the failing record states; this round did not run a separate baseline browser for that finding.
- After checks used both the actual production Next application with disposable PostgreSQL and a bounded React component harness. Browser checks covered **1440, 1024, 390 and 320px**, Enter/click/Escape, meaningful focus, long lists, filtering, checkbox selection, Back/Forward, reload, evidence anchors, preparation recovery and unsaved/pending-action feedback. The harness denied mutations/providers and is not a substitute for server authorization checks.
- **Eight existing integration suites passed:** assignments, reading, tutoring, class fixture, patterns, interventions, intervention HTTP, and intervention approval lessons with follow-ups using supported injected-fixture inputs. A supplemental unchanged legacy approval suite passed against a preexisting authored fixture. These verify authorization, original evidence/source versions, counterevidence, distinct students, stale/replayed/unknown requests, recipients, delivery and follow-up recovery.
- Fresh isolated PostgreSQL restart/durability checks passed. Six additional correction HTTP cases and five prior-repair HTTP cases passed. Six evidence/draft/request table fingerprints were unchanged across final GET-only checks; selected original fixture records also remained identical after the integration work.
- All local data were fictional; provider calls were disabled; **zero paid model calls**. Fixtures do not establish actual-model acceptance.
- Integration setup initially encountered missing fictional credentials, expected authentication/generation limits, a legacy provider-name heuristic and a streamed-HTML parser false failure. Credentials/harness inputs were corrected or supported existing-fixture mode was used. No quota, authorization check, assertion, provenance or production code was weakened. Full logs retain these attempts.
- Combined source snapshot with PR #113 head `2b490863cc6de69a7659f1df1e4628bc22dd7d9a`: **554 tests**, lint and typecheck passed; all eight PR #113 files preserved. A new combined build/runtime/browser acceptance was not executed.
- [CI run on this exact commit](https://github.com/peterbucci/ai-teaching-platform/actions/runs/40163886032): **quality — success; intervention-approval — success**. The two annotations are informational Ubuntu runner-image migration notices.
- A separate read-only engineering pass found no new blocking defect in the corrective diff. Another independent acceptance review is requested; passing CI is not PR acceptance.
- Before/after screenshots, reproduction outputs, exact fixture identities and the consolidated verification report are retained in this Codex task's local deliverables.

## Shared contracts and remaining acceptance

[Shared contracts and ownership](https://github.com/peterbucci/ai-teaching-platform/blob/codex/teacher-workbench-slice/docs/TEACHER_WORKBENCH_CONTRACTS.md) describe authoritative navigation, destination scope, evidence history/focus and blocked-navigation behavior. The separate shared-shell owner received the exact corrective SHA and these behavioral requirements. The new shell still needs its own integrated acceptance.

The reported 61-checkbox narrowing/recovery path was not reverified or repaired in this four-finding task. True 200% zoom was attempted but the browser shortcut had no measurable effect; it remains unverified. Physical touch, screen-reader, hosted release/demo and actual-model acceptance remain outstanding. Combined PR #113 runtime/browser acceptance is also outstanding. Ambiguous legacy direction storage is intentionally not auto-restored; preparation recovery remains tab-local.

Broader Patterns presentation, Students trails, Lessons/Assignments restructuring and copilot remain in their existing work. Keep this PR **draft and isolated from the release candidate** pending independent review. PR #113 student files and PR #111 visual contracts are untouched. No issues are closed by this partial slice.

Refs #8, #18, #35, #114.

This finishing pass corrects V06 pane geometry, V07 reading consistency and V08 published assignment preparation while preserving existing material, objective, question, approval and immutable-publication services.

Refs #114, #20, #49 and #50. **Keep draft and unmerged.** No parent completion or live-model acceptance is claimed.

## Changes

- Remove duplicate desktop local navigation and nested shell padding; use a 330px outline / flexible editor / 360px reading pane at 1440px. Tablet reading uses a 400px native modal; phones use mounted Outline/Editor/Reading panes.
- Present exact source passages consistently across objectives, questions, review and published lessons: 15px serif, 1.55 line height, preserved text, passage IDs, attribution and source version.
- Keep lesson identity visible in the published editor. Put exact-version class assignment preparation before snapshots/history; retain existing inactive quick preparation as a secondary control.
- Preserve unsaved edits across local pane/objective changes, Escape/Close opener focus and breakpoint transitions. No authoring pipeline, database, resolver or tutoring-controller changes.
- Preserve importer/extraction review, manual and AI-suggested objectives, merge/reorder/review, question IDs and private criteria, draft revisions/recovery, separate approvals/publication and immutable history.

Changes are confined to Lessons, Materials and Objectives, including focused tests/styles/evidence. Shared shell and Assignments files remain untouched.

## Verification

Fictional data only; providers disabled; no paid model calls.

Latest report/evidence commit: `1bad60ce76b4d1a11f044f1edb020f07ee3ab22f` (application source unchanged).
Application source: `53e494a639d82bd8daa9dfb7655a23ebca3aa9c4`.

Final-source local focused authoring tests: 27 passed, including three exact-version handoff regressions.
- Combined native runtime: 625 tests passed, production build passed, authenticated assignment and publishing HTTP checks passed.
- Captured prototype/before/final comparisons at 1440×1000, 1024×768, 390×844 and 320×844. Final published and question pages have no document horizontal overflow at these sizes.
- Browser checks passed for source/original extraction, objective and question reading, teacher-only criteria/student preview separation, prepared tutoring policy, separate approval then publication, new draft editing/readiness invalidation and original published objective preservation.
- Tablet reading Escape restores its opener; phone Close restores the previous editor and Reading control focus. Unsaved objective text survives Next/Previous objective selection.
- C5 outgoing published-version1 link opens the Assignments receiving form with version1 selected while version2 exists. Publication created no assignment.
- Independent shell-agent recovery/denied-storage checks passed on the earlier `b8d0eb55` combined runtime; final shell Escape/return regressions passed on `9ca10189`. These are separately attributed.

**Remaining acceptance gaps:** actual 200% native browser zoom could not run because the Chrome app-access approval prompt timed out. The final IAB Emphasis control received focus but its native expanded menu was not verified. An earlier IAB question-editor reload/navigation became unresponsive, so that attempt is not counted as a recovery pass. Full assistive-technology, hosted deployment and actual-model acceptance are not claimed.

[Verification report and visual comparisons](https://github.com/peterbucci/ai-teaching-platform/blob/1bad60ce76b4d1a11f044f1edb020f07ee3ab22f/app/teacher/lessons/verification/v22-finish.html) distinguish final source, combined runtime, historical evidence and limitations. The shared app/guard was released; PostgreSQL/data were retained.

## Explicit #117 integration contract

The published lesson sends:
`/teacher/assignments/new?lesson=<authorized-lesson-id>&version=<exact-selected-published-version>&class=<optional-owned-class-id>`

The version comes from the authorized immutable snapshot, never a newest-version fallback. Lessons owns this outgoing action; PR #117 owns receiving selection/authorization, teacher review, assignment creation and separate activation. Publication neither creates nor activates an assignment. This contract was verified against the combined receiving form; no Assignments files changed.

## Dependencies and remaining design differences

- PR #120 supplies the shared focused-route navigation/insets; this branch consumes that shell. PR #117 supplies assignment receiving/review/activation. PR #122 remains the combined acceptance track.
- The dense comparison uses five concepts, 13 passages and 19 snapshots versus the prototype’s 15 bank questions; class states/version counts differ and are disclosed. Four-question editable fixtures separately test the active editor.
- Exact raw source line breaks/markers are preserved. The font stack names Source Serif 4 with Georgia fallback; this change does not bundle or prove that the prototype font is installed.
- Existing material-review heading sizes and the selected-family tutoring limitation remain. The UI does not promise that every bank question appears during tutoring.
- Keep this PR draft. Complete the bounded native zoom/menu and question-recovery retests before claiming full visual/accessibility acceptance.

prs.body:
Students now see the accepted answer result, and interrupted saves no longer claim that the server saved work it never received.

S-01 uses the existing completion component: it displays the latest submitted answer’s matching accepted evaluation, preserving correct/partial/incorrect/uncertain wording, concept results, uncertainty, assistance and private-criteria boundaries. The original acceptance case already passed on prior PR113 head `2b490863cc6de69a7659f1df1e4628bc22dd7d9a`; that result is recorded rather than replaced.

S-02 was reproduced on that same head: an initial precommit 401 left no server answer but displayed “Your submitted work is saved.” Recovery now distinguishes locally retained text, unconfirmed save, unknown outcome and explicit server acknowledgment. It preserves the exact original answer and submission key, requires read-only reconciliation before an explicit retry, and never submits or evaluates merely because the student refreshes or returns from sign-in. Adds a server-side SHA-256 helper for visual activity snapshots, so the runtime can check that a stored snapshot matches the hash in a tool request. ### Implementation and exported boundaries
- Authenticated `ConversationTransport` operations: GET/POST `/api/tutoring/:sessionId/conversation`, POST `.../display`, and GET `.../operations/:requestId` for safe read-only recovery. Authorized teacher GET `/api/teacher/sessions/:sessionId/conversation` and the existing teacher session detail expose the corresponding evidence.
- Immutable original payloads and session/assignment/attempt/source/revision anchors; proposed intent is separate from authorized routing. Exact generated snapshots, action proposals, validation, dispatch and actual results have separate durable records.
- `reserveConversationOperation`, `commitConversationIntent`, `commitConversationHelp`, `createReservedCall`, and `createOrchestrationPersistence` are server-only integration seams. No browser endpoint accepts trusted model review or action history.
- Session locking, identical-request replay, changed-payload rejection, current-state rechecks, durable cancellation, bounded shared provider reservations and read-only reconciliation. One call per classify/propose/generate/review stage; no retry API or SDK retry loop.
- Accepted help creates an undelivered existing intervention. Only its exact conversation display acknowledgment timestamps assistance. Legacy tutor delivery excludes those records and cannot acknowledge them. Submission-time assistance and previous evaluations stay immutable.

Legacy evaluator start markers also consume the 36-call session budget and cannot overlap unresolved dialogue calls. Because legacy `evaluation_failed` records lack reliable external-outcome metadata, those reservations remain conservatively unresolved until a known accepted/rejected outcome exists.
